snippet.title: "Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket-" PV for PlayStation®4
snippet.description:
■Store URL: https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/concept/10011031
■Release date: October, 2024 0:00 a.m. (*Subject to change slightly.)
■Languages: Japanese/English/Simplified Chinese

The tenth in the series--released just in time for the 10th anniversary of “Tsugunohi” on December 22, 2022.
“Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket-” is set in a supermarket after its closing.

This title, which received a great response upon its release for its enhanced depiction of horror and a story that emphasizes the relationships between the characters, is finally coming to the PlayStation®4!

■STORY
Recently, shoplifting has been happening frequently at the supermarket where high school student Yumi Kiritachi has started working part-time.
Time has been passing without catching the shoplifters, but it seems that it is not humans who are taking the merchandise.
-----------------------—

■“Tsugunohi” series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has created a number of horror titles. “Tsugunohi” is one of his best-known works.
Tsugunohi” series is characterized by its unique horror experience. As you repeatedly “walk to the left” on your usual way home or to your workplace, your daily life will eventually become distorted and a deep sense of fear will envelop you.
Please enjoy the horror as your daily life gradually changes into something more disturbing.

Official website ▶ https://www.gamemaga.jp/tsugunohi/
Official X website ▶ https://x.com/tsugunohi

©ImCyan/Vaka, Inc.
